name: planning-grid
title: Planning grid
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Hierarchical plan by period. Actual stays solid, forecast stays light, and a growth slider spreads the forecast without touching locked cells.

meta.descriptionEs: Plan jerárquico por periodo. El real queda sólido, el pronóstico claro, y el deslizador reparte sin tocar celdas bloqueadas.

examples.title: Metas por responsable
examples.description: Norte y Sur, de enero a diciembre, en pesos.

api.name: rows / periods
api.description: Groups contain children. A period is actual or forecast. The first forecast column is the cutoff.

api.name: spread / outlookOf / applyGrowth
api.description: spread(total, weights, locks) keeps locked numbers. outlook is actual plus forecast. applyGrowth pushes a percent onto unlocked forecast cells.

api.name: baseline / onSave / onRowsChange
api.description: A cell that differs from baseline shows a dot. Save, revert, undo, and redo stay on the host's copy.

api.name: heat
api.description: Heat scale for the whole view, each row, or each column.

api.name: labels
api.description: English chrome. money formats the values. fresh is the label of a line added with Enter.

docs: Clean-room planning grid. No ReUI source, sample rows, or assets were copied. Uses useLegacyTable and getExpandedRowModel. Arrow keys move, Enter edits, Escape cancels, and the host owns paste when the clipboard is available. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite button, dropdown-menu, input, or skeleton. No theme, cssVars, or palette colors. Motion on the chevron is skipped when reduced motion is set.
